entries.source: Brave the Unknown
entries.translation: 勇闯未知
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54193

entries.source: The Bonfire beckons you on a journey to vanquish the darkness that plagues this world.
entries.translation: 篝火召唤你踏上旅程，扫除荼毒这个世界的黑暗。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54193

entries.source: Begin your adventure.
entries.translation: 开始冒险。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54193

entries.source: A new set of enemies may appear on each floor.
entries.translation: 每个楼层都可能出现一批新的敌人。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54193

entries.source: Achieving this world objective enables a new set of enemies to appear on each floor.
entries.translation: 达成这个世界目标后，每个楼层都能出现一批新的敌人。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54193

entries.source: A New Dawn
entries.translation: 新的黎明
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54194

entries.source: The Bonfire calls upon you to vanquish Death and expand its dominion over this world.
entries.translation: 篝火呼唤你击败死神，让它的统御遍及这个世界。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54194

entries.source: Defeat Death.
entries.translation: 击败死神。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54194

entries.source: Unlocks a set of alternate floors to appear, bringing new events to discover and foes to defeat with it.
entries.translation: 解锁一批可能出现的替代楼层，带来新的事件与敌人。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54194

entries.source: Achieving this world objective unlocked a set of alternate floors.
entries.translation: 达成这个世界目标后，已解锁一批替代楼层。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54194

entries.source: Beyond Tomorrow
entries.translation: 明日之后
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54195

entries.source: The Bonfire has sensed something beyond Death and implores you to persevere on your quest to unravel the curse of mortality.
entries.translation: 篝火感知到死神之外还有某种存在，恳请你坚持探索，解开凡人必死的诅咒。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54195

entries.source: Defeat Death with 5 different classes.
entries.translation: 使用 5 个不同职业击败死神。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54195

entries.source: Unlocks the gate to the Shadow Planes.
entries.translation: 解锁通往暗影位面的门。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54195

entries.source: Achieving this world objective unlocked the gate to the Shadow Planes.
entries.translation: 达成这个世界目标后，已解锁通往暗影位面的门。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54195

entries.source: Echoes of the Forgotten
entries.translation: 遗忘之地的回响
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54196

entries.source: The Bonfire urges you to delve into the eerie depths beyond death and confront the lurking tyrant that dwells within these forgotten shadows.
entries.translation: 篝火催促你深入死亡彼端的幽暗深处，迎战潜伏在遗忘暗影中的暴君。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54196

entries.source: Defeat the guardian of the Shadow Planes.
entries.translation: 击败暗影位面的守护者。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54196

entries.source: Unlocks ethereal shops and enables unlocking new classes.
entries.translation: 解锁虚灵商店，并开放新职业的解锁途径。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54196

entries.source: Achieving this world objective unlocked ethereal shops and enabled paths to unlock new classes.
entries.translation: 达成这个世界目标后，已解锁虚灵商店，并开放新职业的解锁途径。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54196

entries.source: The End?
entries.translation: 终结？
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54197

entries.source: The Bonfire tells you to descend deeper into the realm of shadows to vanquish the eternal grip of Death once and for all.
entries.translation: 篝火指引你深入暗影领域，彻底挣脱死神永恒的掌控。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54197

entries.source: Defeat Primal Death.
entries.translation: 击败原初死神。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54197

entries.source: Achieving this world objective unlocked the gates to the High Heavens and Burning Hells.
entries.translation: 达成这个世界目标后，已解锁通往至高天堂与燃烧地狱的门。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54197

entries.source: Whispers of Brimstone
entries.translation: 硫磺低语
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54198

entries.source: Defeating death in its primal form has revealed yet another potential path in a souls journey. The Bonfire charges you with traveling to the Burning Hells to discover the secrets of the afterlife.
entries.translation: 击败原初形态的死神后，灵魂的旅途又出现了新的道路。篝火委托你前往燃烧地狱，探寻来世的秘密。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54198

entries.source: Defeat the guardian of the Burning Hells.
entries.translation: 击败燃烧地狱的守护者。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54198

entries.source: Unlocks infernal shops and enables unlocking new classes.
entries.translation: 解锁地狱商店，并开放新职业的解锁途径。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54198

entries.source: Achieving this world objective unlocked infernal shops and enabled paths to unlock new classes.
entries.translation: 达成这个世界目标后，已解锁地狱商店，并开放新职业的解锁途径。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54198

entries.source: Visions of Starlight
entries.translation: 星光幻景
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54199

entries.source: Defeating death in its primal form has revealed yet another potential path in a souls journey. The Bonfire charges you with traveling to the High Heavens to discover the secrets of the afterlife.
entries.translation: 击败原初形态的死神后，灵魂的旅途又出现了新的道路。篝火委托你前往至高天堂，探寻来世的秘密。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54199

entries.source: Defeat the guardian of the High Heavens.
entries.translation: 击败至高天堂的守护者。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54199

entries.source: Unlocks angelic shops and enables unlocking new classes.
entries.translation: 解锁天使商店，并开放新职业的解锁途径。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54199

entries.source: Achieving this world objective unlocked angelic shops and enabled paths to unlock new classes.
entries.translation: 达成这个世界目标后，已解锁天使商店，并开放新职业的解锁途径。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / resources.assets / 54199

entries.source: The Pact
entries.translation: 契约
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / sharedassets1.assets / 321

entries.source: Conquer heaven and hell and find the keys to unlock the remaining locks that seal away the Abyss.
entries.translation: 征服天堂与地狱，寻找钥匙，解开封印深渊的其余锁链。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / sharedassets1.assets / 321

entries.source: Sit on the celestial and infernal throne.
entries.translation: 坐上天堂与地狱的王座。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / sharedassets1.assets / 321

entries.source: Unlocks access to the Abyss.
entries.translation: 解锁通往深渊的道路。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / sharedassets1.assets / 321

entries.source: Achieving this world objective unlocks the sealed gate to the Abyss. <color=grey>In the next expansion. Not available yet.</color>
entries.translation: 达成这个世界目标后，将解锁封印深渊的大门。<color=grey>将在下次扩展中推出。暂未开放。</color>
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / sharedassets1.assets / 321

entries.source: Beyond Good and Evil
entries.translation: 善恶之外
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / sharedassets1.assets / 322

entries.source: The Bonfire challenges you to uncover the secrets of the abyss. Enter the previously sealed gate and discover what lies beyond the realm of order.
entries.translation: 篝火要你探寻深渊的秘密。进入曾被封印的大门，揭开秩序领域之外的真相。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / sharedassets1.assets / 322

entries.source: Enter and vanquish the first level of the Abyss.
entries.translation: 进入并征服深渊的第一层。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；World_Progression.WorldObjective / sharedassets1.assets / 322
